```{r}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| include: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(plm)
library(mice)
library(naniar)
library(knitr)

finaldata <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "final_data.csv"))

finaldata <- finaldata |>
    mutate(loggdp = log(gdp_1000)) |>
    select(-gdp_1000)

summary(finaldata)
colSums(is.na(finaldata))
```

## Fitting the Complete-Case Models 
```{r}
preds <- as.formula(" ~ armed_conflict + loggdp + oecd + pop_dens + urban +age_dep + male_edu + temp + rainfall_1000 + earthquake + drought")


fit_model <- function(outcome) {
    formula <- update.formula(
        preds, 
        paste(outcome, "~ .")
    )
    plm(
        formula, 
        index =c("iso", "year"),
        effect = "twoways", 
        model = "within",
        data = finaldata
    )
}

matmor_cc <- fit_model("maternal_mortality")
under5_cc <- fit_model("under5_mortality")
infant_cc <- fit_model("infant_mortality")
neonatal_cc <- fit_model("neonatal_mortality")

```

## Run Multiple Imputation

```{r}
#| eval: false
midata <- finaldata |>
    mutate(iso_num = as.numeric(as.factor(iso))) |>
    select(-iso)

mice0 <- mice(
    midata,
    seed = 100, 
    m = 10,
    maxit = 0,
    printFlag = FALSE
)

meth <- mice0$method
continuous_vars <- c("urban", "male_edu", "temp", "rainfall_1000",
"loggdp", "pop_dens", "maternal_mortality", "infant_mortality",
"neonatal_mortality", "under5_mortality")

meth[continuous_vars] <- "2l.lmer"

pred <- mice0$predictorMatrix

pred[continuous_vars, "iso_num"] <- -2

mice.multi.out <- mice(
    midata, 
    seed = 100, 
    m = 10, 
    maxit = 20, 
    method = meth, 
    predictorMatrix = pred
)
dir.create(here("output"), showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
    mice.multi.out,
    file = here("output", "mice_out_week8.rds")
)
```


```{r}
mice.multi.out <- readRDS(
  here("output", "mice_out_week8.rds")
)

mice.multi.out$m
mice.multi.out$iteration

plot(mice.multi.out)
```



## Fitting the Four Models After Imputation


```{r}
mi_preds <- as.formula(
    ~ -1 + armed_conflict + loggdp + oecd +
    pop_dens + urban + age_dep + male_edu +
    temp + rainfall_1000 + earthquake + drought +
    as.factor(iso_num) + as.factor(year)
)

fit_mi <- function(outcome) {

  model_formula <- update.formula(
    mi_preds,
    paste(outcome, "~ .")
  )

  fits <- lapply(
    seq_len(mice.multi.out$m),
    function(i) {
      lm(
        model_formula,
        data = mice::complete(mice.multi.out, action = i)
      )
    }
  )

  mice::as.mira(fits)
}

matmor_mi <- fit_mi("maternal_mortality")
under5_mi <- fit_mi("under5_mortality")
infant_mi <- fit_mi("infant_mortality")
neonatal_mi <- fit_mi("neonatal_mortality")

matmor_pool <- pool(matmor_mi)
under5_pool <- pool(under5_mi)
infant_pool <- pool(infant_mi)
neonatal_pool <- pool(neonatal_mi)

```

## Creating the Table 

```{r}
get_cc <- function(model) {

  b <- coef(model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))

  data.frame(
    term = names(b),
    CC = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      b,
      b - 1.96 * se,
      b + 1.96 * se
    )
  )
}

get_mi <- function(model) {

  s <- summary(model, conf.int = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    term = s$term,
    MI = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      s$estimate,
      s[["2.5 %"]],
      s[["97.5 %"]]
    )
  )
}
make_table <- function(cc_model, mi_model, outcome) {

  cc <- get_cc(cc_model)
  mi <- get_mi(mi_model)

  merge(cc, mi, by = "term") |>
    filter(term %in% all.vars(preds)) |>
    mutate(Outcome = outcome)
}

table9 <- bind_rows(
  make_table(matmor_cc, matmor_pool, "Maternal mortality"),
  make_table(under5_cc, under5_pool, "Under-5 mortality"),
  make_table(infant_cc, infant_pool, "Infant mortality"),
  make_table(neonatal_cc, neonatal_pool, "Neonatal mortality")
) |>
  select(Outcome, term, CC, MI)

table9_wide <- table9 |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(CC, MI),
    names_to = "Analysis",
    values_to = "Estimate"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Outcome,
    values_from = Estimate
  ) |>
  mutate(
    term = factor(term, levels = all.vars(preds)),
    Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = c("CC", "MI"))
  ) |>
  arrange(term, Analysis) |>
  mutate(
    term = as.character(term),
    term = ifelse(Analysis == "MI", "", term)
  )
knitr::kable(
  table9_wide,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = "Comparison of Complete-Case and Multiple-Imputation Regression Results",
  col.names = c(
    "Predictor",
    "Analysis",
    "Maternal",
    "Under-5",
    "Infant",
    "Neonatal"
  ),
  align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")
) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    font_size = 7,
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```
